sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Methotrexate binding and uptake assays: minor effects on both binding and uptake relative to wild-type RFC.
sites.rationale: Pro-297 falls squarely within ECL4 (289-307), confirmed by Python lookup (seq[296]='P'). It sits 9 residues from the TM7 C-terminus (288) and 11 residues from the TM8 N-terminus (308), well clear of both TM boundaries. The paper explicitly names this residue as the insertion point in the external loop between TM7 and TM8, and the HA-tagged full-length construct retained near-normal methotrexate binding and uptake. Full-length hRFC expressed in mammalian cells with HA epitope inserted at Pro-297, located in the extracellular loop between TM7 and TM8 (ECL4, residues 289-307). Each construct also carried a C-terminal EGFP fusion to monitor expression.

sources.claim: The hemagglutinin epitope insertion mutants were also tested for their effects on the function of the reduced folate carrier. For these studies, each of the constructs had a carboxyl-terminal fusion of the enhanced green fluorescent protein to monitor and quantitate expression. Insertions into the external loop between transmembrane regions 7 and 8 (Pro-297), the cytoplasmic loop between transmembrane regions 6 and 7 (Ser-225), and near the cytoplasmic amino and carboxyl termini (Pro-20 and Gly-492, respectively) had minor effects on methotrexate binding and uptake.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Methotrexate binding and uptake assays: insertion selectively interfered with uptake but not binding — uptake was reduced while binding was preserved.
sites.rationale: Pro-427 falls within ECL6 (419-431), confirmed by Python lookup (seq[426]='P'). It sits 9 residues from the TM11 C-terminus (418) and 5 residues from the TM12 N-terminus (432), satisfying the ≥3-residue TM-clearance rule on both sides. The paper explicitly names this residue as the insertion point in the external loop between TM11 and TM12. However, the HA insertion selectively impaired uptake (not binding), indicating partial functional perturbation; ranked below Pro-297 accordingly. Full-length hRFC expressed in mammalian cells with HA epitope inserted at Pro-427, located in the extracellular loop between TM11 and TM12 (ECL6, residues 419-431). Construct also carried a C-terminal EGFP fusion.

sources.claim: The insertion into the cytoplasmic loop between transmembrane regions 10 and 11 (Gln-385) greatly reduced both binding and uptake of methotrexate, whereas the insertion into the external loop between transmembrane regions 11 and 12 (Pro-427) selectively interfered with uptake but not binding.

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (9 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: Eight additional ledger-grounded positions were evaluated and excluded from sites because they are intracellular or function-abrogating: (1) L1 Pro-20 and Ser-225 — intracellular N-terminal and TM6-TM7 cytoplasmic loop respectively; (2) L1 Gly-492 — intracellular C-terminal tail (453-591); (3) L2 Gln-385 — the paper labels this the cytoplasmic loop between TM10 and TM11; our topology places residue 385 at the last position of TM10 (363-385) and Q at position 386 in the adjacent intracellular loop (386-397); either reading is non-extracellular, and the insertion greatly reduced both binding and uptake; (4) L3/L7 C-terminal HA and EGFP — the C-terminus (591) is intracellular (453-591); (5) L4/L5 HA after Glu-226 — intracellular loop (204-268); (6) L4/L6 Myc-His10 after Leu-537 — intracellular C-tail (453-591); (7) L8 BRIL fused to N-terminus of TM1 — the junction is after residue 27, which is intracellular (1-27); (8) L8 anti-Fab nanobody fused to C-terminus of TM12 — the junction is after residue 452 (last TM12 residue), leading into the intracellular C-tail (453-591). ECL1 (49-67) contains the N58 glycosylation site (confirmed: seq[57]='N') and no ledger line reports a tolerated insertion there, so no ECL1 site is proposed. ECL2 (114-120), ECL3 (178-184), and ECL5 (357-362) are not supported by any ledger line and are not proposed.
